pin.estimand: token_delta over one complete ceiling statement with a typed renewal mechanism and resolved scope: registered cap statement minus the shortest complete careful-English statement of the same ceiling and renewal mechanism; count noun, number, typed window or held-set scope and every reference are preserved verbatim; definition/teaching sentences are excluded; population: 32 prospectively authored complete cap statements: 16 rate-cap statements over typed per-clock/per-any windows and 16 stock-cap statements over named held sets, spanning API, storage, scheduling, licensing, connection, physical-space and workflow limits; aggregation: equal-item mean per tokenizer over all 32 complete statements, then the maximum (least-favourable) tokenizer mean; rate-cap and stock-cap are both load-bearing and reported separately
admissibility_gates: every frozen English and Ainglish string is countable

measurement_window.boundary: Current clock only, not a runtime estimate or guarantee of later filing. Existing stage, role, budget and evidence rules still apply. A stage change during work can require an evidenced abort instead of a measurement.
